question: In Phase 13, how much of the clean-v3 ORACLE regional-resolution benefit is retained using a deployable GT-free localizer?
evidence_fields: T_g, T_o, T_p, G, R, D_g, D_o, D_p, size-stratum recall90, proposal precision, proposals/image, ROI area fraction
candidate_criterion: Candidate: R clearly above zero AND D_p not materially below D_g AND the recovery is not confined to a single architecture. Exact numeric thresholds NOT frozen.
